Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Enticement
Serpentis
Only usable if you control the Edge
ser: (D) Burn the Edge to cause your prey to burn 2 pool.
Your minions cannot attempt bleed actions for the remainder
of the turn.
SER: As above, but your prey burns 3 pool.

Nice card. A free "bleed" for 3.
And even though you can't *bleed* afterwards, you can still use
Jazz Wentworth or Regaining the Upper Hand to do it again...

But my question is this:

If Enticement is blocked, do you still burn the Edge?
I am guessing no. But I wanted to make sure.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <0AyV6.25818$_Y5.45...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net>, Jozxyqk
<jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> writes

>ser: (D) Burn the Edge to cause your prey to burn 2 pool.
> Your minions cannot attempt bleed actions for the remainder
> of the turn.

>If Enticement is blocked, do you still burn the Edge?

>I am guessing no. But I wanted to make sure.

"<Do X> to <Do Y>" is the phrasing of a cost, and this is a cost that
would only take place if the action resolved anyway.
